groups.reason: New or changed fonts, artwork, ROM/demo data or notices expand the source/distribution scope. They are outside the original-only payload selection.
required_before_adoption: Actual incorporated-component and provenance review
Allowlist original payload and retain exact notices
Qualify any newly selected content or native dependency separately

groups.reason: Controller repeat/idle/wake, display/font caching and shared menu/model contracts changed. Existing embedded source bindings target the pinned tree.
required_before_adoption: Exact-source embedded owner and input/display/audio regression checks
Rebase source seams and verify classic fallback
Device text/controller, appearance, launch/return and sustained resource scenes

groups.reason: Runtime/principal, power, USB, libc mounts or native helper identities changed. Preserve the qualified-source boundary and review each authority before a new candidate.
required_before_adoption: Rebase exact private source seams and pass strict host certification
D02/D03 actual recovery and loader/kernel/writer inventory
D05/D06 affected boot, launch/return, power/sleep, USB and storage cases

groups.reason: Engine binaries, native settings, controller defaults or source internals differ. The project deliberately keeps installed/native candidates separately identified.
required_before_adoption: R04 exact new binaries, corresponding sources and reproducible compiler/build custody
R06 actual incorporated components, licences and notices
N01 controls, save compatibility, recovery and measured scenes; N02 separate same-boot Resume

groups.reason: Achievements/proxy/accent and other app changes add network/cache/writer or theme work outside the current core candidate. Hold them with the base revision.
required_before_adoption: Separate feature/scope and credentials/cache/writer review
Review controller/display hooks and failed launch/return
New source and affected device qualification before selection

groups.reason: Direct changes primarily target excluded platforms; shared helpers and factory dispatch still require integration review. No additional hardware support is selected.
required_before_adoption: Prove excluded-platform changes cannot alter original TG5040 dispatch
Review all shared dependencies and run exact-source host checks
New hardware programme for any newly supported platform

groups.reason: PortMaster generation, XDG/HOME/PATH or helper/runtime selection changes can alter selected executable and save ownership.
required_before_adoption: P01 exact installed generation/self-update/runtime inventory
P03 stage-aware readiness and external save/undo checks
P04 each selected title actual save/quit/reload, failure/retry and cleanup

groups.reason: Release automation, documentation or remaining configuration changed upstream. The frozen candidate does not adopt the moving branch.
required_before_adoption: Review scope and source/package allowlists
Keep inherited public release automation isolated
New exact release descriptor and corresponding qualification if adopted
